name: Trevor Dwyer
tagline: Making SQL Server do things it was never meant to do, and writing about data, retro computing and life.
bio:
I've spent more than thirty years designing relational databases, starting on an AS/400 in a warehouse with the plan upside down. These days I make SQL Server do things it was never built for: running Doom, Elite and a ZX Spectrum, playing music, carving 3D shapes and training a small language model, all in T-SQL.

I write about data, the machines I grew up with, and the occasional story from life. Every article here was first published on Medium.
